_comment: 1.8.7 Marlow Pike's fish stall on the north beach by the dock. He SELLS fish to the player at steep prices (ridiculously above the barn price, so nothing can be flipped), in limited daily stock that refreshes when he opens. He is a NIGHT trader: `hours` is local time on a 24 hour clock, close is exclusive, and a close earlier than the open means it runs past midnight (19 to 7 = 7 pm to 7 am). Out of hours he is away and the stall is closed. The stock refreshes each time he opens. Quantities are small on purpose. Which fish: any common, uncommon or rare species the player's level can reach (Pier fish once the Pier is rebuilt); legendary and mythic fish are never for sale. Daily choices are seeded by the farm seed and the local day.
name: Marlow Pike
